description: This is a C# source code file implementing a Roslyn code fix provider named GenerateAliasAttributesCodeFix. It provides code fix actions for diagnostics identified by the GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer, adding alias attributes to code elements such as interfaces and classes within the Orleans.Analyzers namespace.

classes.name: GenerateAliasAttributesCodeFix
classes.description: A Roslyn CodeFixProvider that adds alias attributes to code elements based on diagnostics from GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Registers code fix actions in response to diagnostics, analyzing syntax nodes to determine appropriate fixes.

methods.name: FixFor
methods.description: Creates and registers a code fix that adds alias attributes to the specified code declaration (method or type).
